items.title: Ripple Wins Final OCC Approval for Trust Bank Behind $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin
items.summary: The federally supervised bank will manage RLUSD's reserves and offer custody, as banking groups fight crypto charters in court.

items.title: Canada’s Draft Stablecoin Rules Cap Redemption Fees at 1% and Ban Yield
items.summary: Ottawa opened a 60-day consultation on draft rules requiring one-to-one reserves and fast redemption from stablecoin issuers, while keeping the ban on paying holders interest.

items.title: Nearly 90% of large businesses are embracing tokenized cash to speed up payments: DBS
items.summary: Stablecoins lead instruments in use or planned at 63%, ahead of tokenized deposits at 53% and tokenized money market funds at 52%.

items.title: VanEck launches diversified ETF combining stocks, bonds and Bitcoin exposure
items.summary: VanEck’s new Wealth Builder ETF targets a 2% Bitcoin allocation, with a permitted range of 1% to 5%, gaining exposure through a spot Bitcoin ETP.

items.title: CFTC sues Utah as battle over prediction market regulation intensifies
items.summary: The CFTC is escalating its legal fight with states, suing Utah after the state filed a lawsuit against prediction market platform Kalshi.
